title: Embedding modes ablation (token_type_pe vs. token_type_nope vs. nope)
question: In the harnessed `cls` variant with `input_ids` held identical across modes at a fixed sequence length L, what do section-coupled `position_ids` (`token_type_pe`) and 16-d `token_type_ids` (`token_type_nope`) contribute to in-distribution convergence speed and sample efficiency compared to causal masking alone (`nope`, matching pure-LM `ar`)? (Zero-shot length generalisation across embedding modes is evaluated separately in `addition`.)
